sections.title: Listening: Free Time & Weather
sections.description: Listen once for gist and again for detail.

audio.transcript: It's raining this morning, so my family is staying indoors. My father is reading and my mother is making tea. I am playing chess with my sister. We usually go cycling on Sundays, but we can't cycle in this weather. The forecast says it will be sunny this afternoon, so we can take photos in the park later.

gistQuestions.explanation: The complete recording supports this main idea.

detailQuestions.explanation: This detail is stated in the recording. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

tip.title: Listening Strategy
tip.text: Use the first listen for context and the second listen to confirm exact details.

sections.title: Speaking: Free Time & Weather
sections.description: Prepare briefly, record your response and review it.
questions: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?
sections.sampleAnswer: I enjoy reading and taking photos. I can play chess, but I can't swim very well. Today it is sunny, so my friends are playing football outdoors.
prompts: Answer every part of the prompt.

tip.title: Speaking Tip
tip.text: Organise your answer into a clear beginning, two details and a short ending.
